caseStudies.title: Mapping 13 legacy nav items to 6 validated domains — from hypothesis to validated IA
caseStudies.summary: Three rounds of tree testing brought Reels navigation from 67.1% task success (V1) to 97.8% (V3) with screened creators. The 6-domain model now reflects how creators actually reason about publishing and discovery — it is no longer a proposal.
caseStudies.businessImpact: Reduced navigation ambiguity for Reels workflows, lowering support load and improving first-publish success

caseStudies.title: Creator Panel demo drove 12% increase in activations in 10 days
caseStudies.summary: Showing 78 creators across 55 cohorts how their feedback was incorporated into the new Feed ranking controls directly influenced feature adoption. Director of Product and Director of Engineering confirmed the uplift was attributed to the panel demo.
caseStudies.businessImpact: Direct product attribution: 12% increase in Feed activations in 10 days from creator validation

caseStudies.title: Designing trust signals for Spark AI caption suggestions
caseStudies.summary: Research found creators distrusted AI-generated captions without visible reasoning. Introduced confidence labels and edit previews — approval rating improved from 34% to 71% in prototype testing.
caseStudies.businessImpact: Accelerated AI feature adoption by establishing trust patterns that reduced stakeholder hesitation

caseStudies.title: Onboarding stepper redesign based on drop-off pattern analysis
caseStudies.summary: Analytics revealed step 4 of sign-up had a 40% drop-off. Redesigned as a single progressive form with clearer username guidance. Stakeholder sign-off achieved in sprint.
caseStudies.businessImpact: Prevented potential 40% user drop-off, protecting new account conversion

clientValidation.note: Director of Product and Director of Engineering confirmed Feed control activations are up 12% in 10 days, largely attributed to the creator panel demo showing feedback incorporated.
Positive UAT result — creators completed first Reel publish 40% faster than baseline.
